title: Pi adapter: Rust runtime parity
description: RouterAdapterKind::Pi in rust/src/router.rs with from_name, display_name, resume and data-home handling, configure, session_id and parse_pi_result, identical command shape and observable behavior to Python; unit tests and the shared Gherkin scenarios passing under cargo cucumber.
right_now_summary: Rust support for the Pi adapter is matching Python behavior, with unit and Gherkin tests covering the changes.
